'''Grand Khanum Station''' was a massive [[Limmie/Legends|bolo-ball]] stadium located in [[Capra]], a large [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. The stadium could hold around 150,000 spectators, and was most often used for hosting the [[Galactic Cup of Limmie]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
